name: Turning Back
overview: Scripture calls believers to a decisive commitment to God, warning against turning back or looking back once the path of faith is chosen. God commands repentance and turning away from sin to avoid ruin, emphasizing continual reliance on Him and obedience to His will. Jesus teaches that merely professing faith is insufficient without doing the Father's will, and He highlights the necessity of unwavering focus, as one who looks back after committing to God's kingdom is deemed unfit. True love for Christ is demonstrated by keeping His words, resulting in the indwelling presence of the Father and Son.
